verdict.rationale: Zulip's own channel docs reference a distinct 'guest' role whose access is restricted, since guests cannot freely subscribe to public channels. This shows first-party guest accounts with limited access, but the evidence is a single glancing mention. Missing for 10: documentation of how admins create and invite guest accounts, how guest permissions and channel access are configured, any shared-channel or cross-organization collaboration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access

citations.quote: Everyone other than guests can subscribe to any public or web-public channel.
